groups.title: SquarePants Family
groups.def: SpongeBob's immediate household: his parents, his grandmother, and his pet snail (not the wider extended SquarePants family tree of aunts, uncles, and cousins).

groups.title: Superheroes & Villains
groups.def: Members of the in-universe Mermaid Man franchise, hero or villain.

groups.title: Fish
groups.def: Characters whose species is an ordinary fish (not a sponge, crab, or other specific species).

groups.title: Humanoid
groups.def: Characters whose species is a human-shaped sea being, like a merman or mermaid (not a fish, sponge, or other invertebrate).

groups.title: Pirates
groups.def: Pirates, living or ghostly, who appear in the show.

groups.title: Royalty
groups.def: Kings, princes, and princesses of the sea shown in the show.

groups.title: Sea Sponge
groups.def: Every sea sponge character in the show.

groups.title: Surface World
groups.def: Characters established as live-action or otherwise from the human world above the sea.

groups.title: Married Couples
groups.def: Characters shown or clearly established on screen as half of a married pair.

groups.title: Worked at the Chum Bucket
groups.def: Characters shown holding a job at the Chum Bucket at some point.

groups.title: Boating School
groups.def: Characters shown enrolled as a student at Mrs. Puff's Boating School (not counting Mrs. Puff herself, who is only ever the teacher within this file's cutoff).

groups.title: Movie-Exclusive Characters
groups.def: Characters who appear only in one of the three theatrical movies, never in a regular TV episode (unlike Perch Perkins, who debuted in the 2004 movie but went on to recur in the show).

groups.title: Worked at the Krusty Krab
groups.def: Characters shown holding a job at the Krusty Krab at some point, even briefly.

groups.title: Name Says Their Species
groups.def: Characters whose full name is literally "[Name] the [Species]".
